title.en: Treatment of LNPCP recurrence at an EMR scar

statement.en: ESGE recommends the techniques in the following list be considered best practice for the treatment of LNPCP recurrence at an EMR scar.

text.en: Injecting a scar containing a small residual often creates a canyon effect and should therefore be avoided.

Standard injection and snare technique. This should be performed resecting a margin of normal tissue to isolate the central non-lifting component for snare resection. Consideration should be given to using an underwater technique [148].

Other techniques exist to treat residual or recurrent adenoma at an EMR scar (e. g. full-thickness resection, endoscopic submucosal dissection, hot avulsion, forced argon plasma coagulation, and underwater EMR [149]). They have not been subjected to systematic controlled study in this context and are outside the scope of this competency framework (see also Recommendation 24).
